comment: Simulation suites. Each suite is a named set of registered unit cases with a shared intent. tools/verify.py fails on an empty suite set rather than reporting success, so this file must never be emptied to make a gate green.

bringup-v1.intent: The Stage 0 bring-up core executed against every firmware corpus ELF, compared instruction-by-instruction against an independent Python reference model. This is the differential evidence that the frontend, decoder, ALU, M extension and trap path are architecturally correct; it says nothing about the out-of-order fabric, which does not exist yet.

unit-infrastructure-v1.intent: Leaf infrastructure that everything else reuses: the valid/ready FIFO and skid buffer, the synchronous RAM abstraction, and the simulation harness itself including its refusal to load a malformed image and its enforcement of the cycle limit.

scalar-decode-v1.intent: Decoder and integer execution units against their own independent references, including the reserved-encoding enumeration that keeps a legal-looking decode of an illegal encoding from passing.

scalar-directed-v1.intent: The Stage-1 scalar control path as a set: decode, the integer ALU and branch comparator, bounded fetch with redirect, two-wide rename (single- and two-lane groups), the architectural ROB, the local issue queue, the shared MUL/DIV, the banked PRF, retirement with the committed map, the M-mode CSR file, the interrupt/WFI boundary and the predictor. Each case carries its own independent model and its own mutants; this suite is the regression set that a change to any shared interface (rename/ROB uop identity, PRF tag/generation, CSR table) must be re-run against. It says nothing about the execution fabric: no case here drives two clusters, a remote link or a lease.

not_yet_defined.note: docs/implementation-plan.md I-080 requires four suites at the p0 gate. One is now defined (scalar-directed-v1, above, the Stage-1 regression set). The remaining three are still not defined because the hardware they exercise does not exist yet, and this object must never be treated as satisfying them.
not_yet_defined.blocked_on: scalar-random-v1 and metamorphic-v1 need the integrated core plus the memory path (I-023, I-033..I-038); fabric-transition-v1 needs the lease/remote/ownership state machines (I-024..I-031).
